scope: STOP CLI/HTTP FlowModel path, request display replay, append-after-stop replay, prompt suffix boundary, and selected compatibility regressions

source.stage_method: git archive HEAD of the isolated worktree plus exact owned dirty/untracked overlays; production module __file__ paths were preflighted under this stage

runs.name: cli-flow-green-v18
runs.coverage: Two CLI subprocess/HTTP FlowModel tests cover consumed-but-hidden markers, partial stop and UTF-8 state across continuation, zero-work active-stop mismatch rejection, exact replay, changed-stop retry, append-user after a stopped turn, and exact retry of that new turn. A direct CowTextRequest.text_result assertion ensures an ambiguous marker and pending UTF-8 byte remain hidden during an active partial response. Two separate prompt encoder tests use the real CowPromptEncoder and verify the next suffix inserts EOT without rewriting canonical history.

runs.name: cli-append-after-stop-red-v2
runs.finding: Exact retry of a new user turn with the same stop list failed by restoring the prior stopped matcher (HTTP 400: Cannot feed a stopped text matcher). Fixed by restoring prior matcher state only for resume bindings; new turns begin with a fresh matcher.

limitations: The CLI HTTP workflow uses a synthetic CPU FlowModel and is not a native/GPU serving qualification.

The CLI FlowModel's append-user path uses the existing synthetic presentation-flow suffix callback. Real CowPromptEncoder behavior is checked separately by the two prompt-boundary tests in the same run.
Combined seed plus STOP schema-7/reseed continuity is pending the seed worker's frozen integration; it is not covered by this candidate run.
No GPU, native inference, numerical frontier, or registered full-suite qualification is claimed.
